relNote: Each payment journal posting creates a BankAccountTrans row against the bank account; links to BankAccountTable (the account), LedgerJournalTrans (the journal line), and voucher → GeneralJournalEntry

def.name: BankAccountTrans
def.description: Individual bank transaction line — deposits, withdrawals, fees, and corrections posted via payment journals. Each row represents one movement on a bank account and is linked to a GL voucher via the Voucher field.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.note: FK to the bank account this transaction belongs to

fields.name: Voucher
fields.note: Voucher number linking to the GL GeneralJournalEntry

fields.name: AmountCur
fields.note: Transaction amount in the original currency

fields.name: AmountMST
fields.note: Transaction amount in the accounting (home) currency

fields.name: BankTransType
fields.note: Bank transaction type (e.g. Cheque, Transfer, Wire)

fields.name: Reconciled
fields.note: Reconciliation status flag (0 = not reconciled, 1 = reconciled)

fields.name: Txt
fields.note: Free-text description or memo on the transaction

relNote: Cash discount schedule defining % discount if paid within N days; referenced by CustTrans and VendTrans during settlement

def.name: CashDisc
def.description: Cash discount terms master — defines the percentage discount and payment window (number of days or months) that a customer can claim by paying early. Referenced by CustTrans and VendTrans during invoice settlement.

fields.name: CashDiscCode
fields.note: Primary key — unique code identifying this cash discount schedule

fields.name: Description
fields.note: Human-readable description of the discount terms

fields.name: Percent
fields.note: Discount percentage offered if paid within the window

fields.name: NumOfDays
fields.note: Number of days within which payment must be received to qualify

fields.name: NumOfMonths
fields.note: Number of months (alternative to NumOfDays) for the discount window

fields.name: CashDiscCodeNext
fields.note: Optional link to a follow-on discount code for sequential discount tiers
